description: Eight window comparators in 8HP, each firing a gate or a trigger while a voltage is inside a range set by its own two knobs

params.text: Flips the crossing setting of all eight sections at once
Flips the min-include setting of all eight sections at once
Flips the max-include setting of all eight sections at once
Fires that section's trigger when the input jumps clean across the range from one side to the other without ever reading inside it; gate mode ignores this
Sets the bottom of that section's range, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and 0V unless you move it
Counts a voltage exactly equal to the bottom of that section's range as inside it; on unless you turn it off
Sets the top of that section's range, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise, and 0V unless you move it
Counts a voltage exactly equal to the top of that section's range as inside it; off unless you turn it on
Chooses what that section's output carries: green for a gate held while the input is in range, red for a 1ms trigger when it enters the range

inputs.text: The voltage that section tests; an empty jack reads the nearest patched input above it, so one signal can be split across eight ranges

outputs.text: Carries one channel per section, each with that section's gate or trigger
Carries a gate while the input is inside that section's range, or a 1ms trigger as it enters, according to the button beside it

notes: both knobs of every section come up at 0V, so nothing fires until you open a range
this module reads only channel 1 of a polyphonic input and every output is one channel; the maker chose that to avoid tracking up to 128 triggers at once
in trigger mode a section fires on entering its range and not on leaving it, so catching both edges takes a second section covering the voltages outside
menu: Set crossing 1-8: Disabled, Enabled — sets the crossing buttons of all eight sections at once
Set min-include 1-8: Exclude, Include — sets the min-include buttons of all eight sections at once
Set max-include 1-8: Exclude, Include — sets the max-include buttons of all eight sections at once
Set gate/trigger-output 1-8: To gate, To trigger — sets the output type of all eight sections at once
Poly output channels: 1 (monophonic) up to 8 channels — sets how many of the eight sections the polyphonic jack carries, 8 unless you reduce it
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
Trigger-high output-level — sets the voltage a trigger pulse carries during its 1ms high phase, 10V unless you change it
Trigger-low output-level — sets the voltage a trigger output carries between pulses, 0V unless you change it
